title: Quick change (xs/sm)
short: the quick path: proposed, then built on one letter
blurb: A small change in existing code. Brainstorm grounds the words in the code, sees it is small, and proposes the change in its first turn — reply **A** and it is built. No rounds, no confirm, no sizing turn.

title: Small change, talked through (sm)
short: the full conversation, then built in chat
blurb: A request with real choices in it: the grounded playback, how it works today, rounds (briefing, then the picker — the one menu on screen), confirm, size, the small path's design and approval, then the build — all in chat, no spec.

title: Leaving the conversation early
short: B. Build it now / "just build it"
blurb: Partway through the rounds the user takes **B. Build it now** (or types "just build it"): every open question settles on its recommendation and it sizes straight away.

title: Exploring a vague idea
blurb: An abstract idea enters discovery: open frame questions, research outside the repo offered (and only run on a yes), lettered concepts built from the product's own patterns, then rounds.

title: A feature, end to end (lg)
short: cert-tags: brainstorm → spec → audit → plan → build → walk → verify → ship
blurb: `cert-tags` across `api`, `web` and `mobile`: the whole pipeline from the brainstorm's hand-off to SHIPPED, with the human walk in the middle.

title: A one-app feature (md)
blurb: `cert-history`, web only: the hand-off, then spec, audit and plan in their shorter md form.

title: A program (xl)
blurb: `customer-portal`: the splitting question, PROGRAM.md, the program go-ahead and resume walking the children.

title: From a written spec
blurb: A worked-out spec or ticket goes to `/builder:intake`, which checks its claims against the code instead of exploring from scratch.

title: Replying "go" and numbers
short: the numbered footers, and when go doesn't continue
blurb: Pipeline footers are numbered (brainstorm's are lettered): "go" is 1, a number picks a way on, and some footers "go" never continues.

title: Build here
short: audit and plan, then built in this session
blurb: The `here` option: the audit and plan still run, then this session builds it without the ceremony.

title: Choosing a test plan
short: slices, the three questions, what each costs
blurb: At the go-ahead the plan is shown as slices with the recommended test plan and its cost. **B. Change the test plan** asks three things — testing per slice, testing at the end, and when to review — each option leading with what it costs for this plan; the test-plan lines come back with the new counts, then **A** builds it.

title: When it isn't ready
blurb: The paths that loop back: a build not ready to walk, a walk that found problems, a verify that came back INCOMPLETE.

title: Changing a planned feature
blurb: A change after the plan goes through `/builder:revise` — one ruling at a time.

title: Hand it to agents
blurb: `/builder:agent` picks unfinished features, takes the test plan and landing branch, and runs them through the fleet; an agent walks and signs off in place of the human.

title: Adding to a running fleet
blurb: More specs joining a fleet that is already running, its status mid-run and its final report.

title: Where things stand
blurb: The read-mostly views: the status dashboard, the resume picker, tidy's table, version and the help card.

title: Setting up a repo
blurb: `/builder:init` writes `.claude/builder.md` from what the repo contains and asks only what it can't answer.

title: Session start and the PR lock
short: the brief a session opens with, and gh pr create before the walk
blurb: builder's two hooks, both silent outside a builder repo: the SessionStart brief (where to start, what's in flight, builder's skills over superpowers'), and the PR lock denying `gh pr create` on a feature's branch until it has been walked and signed off.
